// Issue #136: Cid, Timeless Artificer cycles for {W}{U} and draws a card.
//
// Thirteen cards on the play: five Plains, five Islands and three Cids. The
// line names Cid, and its effect is a cycle, so every Cid in hand is cycled
// whenever the turn's lands pay {W}{U} for it, and none is ever cast.
5x Plains [Land]
5x Island [Land]
3x Cid, Timeless Artificer [Cid]
